note: Former NGPC state recreation area on Long Lake, a natural sandhills lake ~3 km long, ~22 mi south of Johnstown via county road. Primitive drive-in camping only when NGPC last listed it (tables, grills, water, pit toilets). Not on NGPC's 2025 rate grid or its current property maps; whether it is still open to the public, and who runs it, is unconfirmed (2026-11). --Claude
summary: Probably no longer an NGPC area: absent from the 2025 rates grid, from NGPC's 2024-25 property and park-boundary layers and from its fishing/ramp layers; Wikipedia (2026-07) lists it as a FORMER SRA; Google has no phone, site or reviews. Only a 2017 NGPC table still calls it active. Stored pin (RV Life's) is in open sandhills ~3 km west of the lake; campground not found on imagery. No group changes; note rewritten with a dated caveat. DROP/STATUS candidate.
flags: STATUS / DROP CANDIDATE (human decides): every current NGPC source omits Long Lake - no row on the 2025 Camping Rates Grid; not in 'NGPC Properties 2024-2025' or 'Park_Areas' (both edited 2026; Brown County shows only Keller Park SRA, Long Pine SRA and WMAs); no public fishing point or boat ramp on the lake. Wikipedia's list moved it to 'Former State Recreation Areas' in July 2026 alongside Pibel Lake, Crystal Lake and Champion Lake (all conveyed to local bodies). The only NGPC record calling it 'Active' is the Parks_Locations table last edited 2017-03-01. Google's 'Long Lake SRA' has no phone, website or reviews. I found no new operator: Middle Niobrara NRD's recreation page (https://www.mnnrd.org/about/recreation) names only Cub Creek and Brewer Bridge Landing; browncountyne.gov returned 403. outdoornebraska.gov/location/long-lake/ is blocked and stayed unread. Either it passed to Brown County / a private owner, or the camping is gone; ownership 'state' is doubtful but I have no replacement.

PIN wrong but no fix: the stored 42.29324,-100.14125 (= RV Life's geoloc) sits in open sandhill pasture ~3 km WEST of Long Lake (GNIS 42.29027,-100.09585). NGPC's 2017 point 42.29271,-100.10378 is just off the SW shore. On Esri and NAIP I found no campground, loop, toilet or tables along the SW shore near that point (only hay ground, fences and a ranch at the SE end ~42.2835,-100.0935). Not moved: nothing seen to pin to. If kept, the NGPC point is the better guess.

PHONE 402-684-2921 is the Keller Park / Long Pine SRA number on the 2025 grid (Long Lake shares their PO Box 508 address in the 2017 table); there is no Long Lake listing for it. apply.py does not write phones.

NOTE: '50-acre natural sandhill lake' was wrong - Long Lake is ~3 km long and ~0.4-0.6 km wide on imagery (several hundred acres); 'Remote NGPC SRA' no longer supported. Rewritten with a dated caveat.

UNVERIFIED (old note prose, left as stored): sites.count 10, hookups.electric 0, vault toilets, potable water, FCFS. NGPC's 2017 table agrees on primitive-only, no electric, water and vault toilets, no reservations.

SAND: sandhills county road access (the old note: '~22 mi south of Johnstown via county road'); whether the last miles are sand two-track I could not tell. No beach camping indicated. WATERFRONT not waterfront kept (campground not located).
